_about: Machine poses for the assembly-manual close-ups. scripts/gen-am-closeups.py merges this with the scoper's shot-list.csv into scripts/am-closeups.json, which scripts/am-closeup-export.rb reads. Keys starting with _ are comments. Components come ONLY from Z:/Sketchup/NewMasterComponentList (Benton, 2026-10-01) plus GENERATED stand-ins in AssemblyCloseups/_generated. A "blocked" variant names the part that is missing and the file name the rig expects.

CU-01._storyboard: cam az 150 el 22, interior, along the wall; seal pulled 3 in off the panel, 1 5/8 in bolts in the air on their axis.
CU-01._differs: Assembled from library parts at their real joint geometry (seal profile and hole positions read off the library faces). The seals are the library profiles (corner L with a 1 x 1 in block; mid-wall T with a 2 in stem), not the storyboard's square post. The library holes put the bolt NORMAL to the panel face (through the panel 2 in from its end, into the seal leg/plate), so the seal is pulled 3 in OUTWARD along that axis and the GENERATED 1 5/8 in bolts sit on those hole lines, backed out of the panel. Framed on the upper half of the joint (z 44..83 in: two bolt lines) so the bolts read; one panel shown.

CU-03._storyboard: cam az 38 el 26, exterior-front 3/4; frame ghosted 35%, lifted 18 in and pulled out 12 in; floor adaptor bolted at the opening (3/4 in chrome); ceiling adaptor off the frame's inside face.
CU-03._differs: Built from the NEW library only: the frame file split two levels (the 46 frame's own nested adaptors hidden) plus the library floor adapters (46 / 40 Door Frame Adapter, WA Door Frame Adapter A) and a STD4848FL floor slab. The top adapter is the floor adapter rotated 180 deg about its long axis, per Benton; for 49 in, B is used at the top and A at the floor (a guess: nothing names which is which). The GENERATED 3/4 in chrome bolts sit on the adapters' real hole lines: down through the floor adapter's flange slots (one bolt per slot, at one slot end), and horizontally through the ceiling adapter's web.

CU-06._storyboard: cam az 30 el 20, wall top; panel below 60 in hidden; extension 8 in up, H-strip 4 in up (exploded); tall seals; plugs into the top inserts.
CU-06._differs: 46PanelSolid_HX split one level (Component#203 = Std wall (46"), "H - strip 22#1" = the 46 in H-strip, misnamed in the library, Component#223 = the 10 in extension), with MidWallSeamSeal_HX (91 in) at both panel edges, stems in the panel band. Below 60 in is removed with a horizontal section (one active plane only), so the H profile is read at the panel END instead of through a vertical section: the near tall seal is hidden to show it. The GENERATED black insert plugs sit in the four wall-top inserts the ceiling brackets use on a non-HX booth (read off the panel's modelled holes); those are on the INTERIOR face, so the view is from inside, not the storyboard's exterior.

CU-08._storyboard: cam az 55 el 14, exterior hinge side, tight on the hinge column; leaf at 90 deg, raised 1 in.
CU-08._differs: Library open-door file split one level: the frame (ghosted 50% in its own material) and the leaf assembly, turned to 90 deg about the hinge-pin axis read off the frame's modelled pins, then raised 1 in. Framed on the hinge column. Hinge anchors are the frame's nested Hinge (door frame) children.

CU-19._storyboard: ident view az 30 el 40; section variant side-on through box + tube, box 8 in above the tube.
CU-19._differs: Not posed: the new library has no RM port tube and no single RM duct box.

ident.blocked: MISSING PART: RM port tube (expected NewMasterComponentList/RM Port Tube.skp) and the exhaust (no ring) / intake (black ring) duct boxes as single parts (RM Duct Box Exhaust.skp, RM Duct Box Intake.skp). RMVentilationExhaustBox / IntakeBox each hold the whole roof set.

section.blocked: MISSING PART: RM port tube (expected NewMasterComponentList/RM Port Tube.skp). The duct box could be split out of RM4872 (VSS duct box#13), but the tube it drops onto is not in the new library.

CU-02._storyboard: cam az 150 el 14, interior low (12 in), 30 deg off the wall; vertical section through the bracket; panel 2 in up; 3/4 in black bolt, started loose.
CU-02._differs: STD4848FL (its nested "Hinge (plastic for attaching ceilings & floors)" is the hinged bracket) and 46PanelSolid placed so the panel's bottom inserts meet the bracket holes (read off both parts). The section is a clip through the bracket's middle; the GENERATED 3/4 in black bolt sits in the bracket's real hole, started 0.4 in.

CU-04._storyboard: cam az 25 el 52, from above-front; ceiling lying on the floor, bracket side up; ceiling adaptor 6 in above its spot; 3/4 in chrome bolts.
CU-04._differs: STD4848CL is used for both the 46 and the 40 in adaptor (their slot spacing is the same 26 in, so the holes line up; the 40 in booth's own ceiling was not identified). The adaptor is the library floor adapter (Benton: the top adapter is the same part); lying on the upside-down ceiling it keeps the floor orientation. The GENERATED 3/4 in chrome bolts are on the adaptor's slot axes, one per slot.

w49.blocked: BLOCKED: no WA/ADA ceiling with the 38 3/4 in adaptor slot spacing was identified in NewMasterComponentList (STD4848CL matches the 46/40 adaptors only).

CU-05._storyboard: cam az 160 el 20, interior at the frame foot; adjacent wall panels ghosted 35%; section through the jamb at the adaptor; nothing exploded.
CU-05._differs: No adjacent wall panels are staged (the shot is the jamb foot). The adaptor is the library 46 Door Frame Adapter seated on the frame's own hole line with GENERATED 3/4 in chrome bolts fully seated (tight). The section is a clip 3 in in from the jamb.

CU-07._storyboard: cam az 160 el -16, interior looking up at the frame head; ceiling lifted 6 in; black plastic hinges replace the ceiling adaptor.
CU-07._differs: Black Hinge placed on the extension's real hinge-bolt holes (derived from the hole pairs; the base sits 0.75 in under the extension top, read off the parts). Ceiling edge = STD4848CL lifted 6 in. GENERATED 3/4 in black bolts seated in the hinge leaves.

CU-24._storyboard: cam az 135 el 48, interior corner, eye at 48 in; Std shell 35%; horizontal section at 40 in; IEP seal 4 in out of the corner; six isolator pads.
CU-24._differs: Std corner = CornerSeamSeal + two 46PanelSolid (ghosted 35% in their own material); IEP seal = ENH CornerSeamSeal / ENH MidWallSeamSeal ("... (with pads)": the pads are part of the library seal, not loose). Section = a clip at 40 in. No floor/ceiling edges (the cut is at 40 in).

CU-25._storyboard: cam az 135 el 20, interior 3/4; Std wall 35%; vertical section through the H-strip; top half 8 in up, strip 4 in up.
CU-25._differs: ENH 41.5PanelSolid split three levels into its two IEP wall halves and the H - strip 41.5; the Std wall behind is 46PanelSolid ghosted 35%. The vertical section is a clip across the wall at mid-length.

CU-26._storyboard: cam az 160 el 20, interior at the frame foot; vertical section through frame / adaptor / jamb; the long bolt on its axis 4 in out.
CU-26._differs: Std frame + library 46 floor adapter + the IEP jamb split out of ENH Left41.5Door_NoDoor (its other parts hidden). The longer bolt is a GENERATED stand-in (length a guess: 3 in) on the shared hole line (frame, adaptor web and jamb holes coincide at y 24.0, z 2), 4 in out of the jamb. The section is a clip through that bolt line. Framed on the floor end for both variants.

CU-30._storyboard: cam az 160 el 15, interior; IEP door 6 in off the Std door; 12 plugs out; 3 centre bolts first.
CU-30._differs: Std leaf (Left46Door, split) + IEP door 30" (ENH Left41.5Door, split; jamb hidden), shown closed rather than open 90 deg. The 12 GENERATED insert plugs are pulled 3 in out of the Std door's 12 inserts; the three GENERATED 1 5/8 in bolts sit in the IEP door's middle-row holes (which three are "centre" is derived: the middle row).

CU-32._differs: CP9648 SIDE + CP9648 CTR placed so their bracket slots sit 2.5 in apart across the joint (read off the slots); the library Caster Plate Attachment Plate over them, lifted 3 in; GENERATED 3/4 in black bolts in the plate's two holes over the slots.

CU-33._storyboard: cam az 210 el 20, low 3/4 across the seam; vertical section across the seam; floors 4 in apart.
CU-33._differs: STDSS FL8 between STD9648FL CTR and STD9648FL SIDE, each floor placed so its strap receiver sits on the seam seal's Floor connector plate (read off the parts); floors pulled 4 in apart. Section = a clip through the connector plate.

CU-40._storyboard: cam az 200 el 15, exterior low 3/4 at the threshold; door ghosted 35%; vertical section through plate + insert; ramp 4 in out; 3/4 in black bolts.
CU-40._differs: LeftWADoorWithRamp_NoDoor split three levels (ramp pieces, RAMP 1 plates, the WA frame). The ramp is pulled 4 in out (-x); GENERATED 3/4 in black bolts on the plates' top holes. The frame is ghosted (no leaf in this file). Section = a clip through one plate's hole line.

CU-09._storyboard: cam az 140 el 20, perspective; interior close at the latch, door ajar 10 deg; a dollar bill at the strike / seal.
CU-09._differs: Left46Door (closed) split one level; the leaf turned 10 deg open about its hinge pins (x 2.15, y 39.04, read off the frame). The GENERATED dollar bill stands in the gap at the latch edge. Parallel projection (the rig's anchors are exact only for parallel); the storyboard asks for perspective.

CU-14._differs: The wall is 46VNT's "Std wall (46" Vnt)" (duct boxes hidden); Duct Cover turned onto its interior face (x 8.55) over the duct openings. The section is a clip through the lower cover.
